read.thesis: Delta held pretax near $1.5B despite $1.6B higher fuel; capacity flat then ~3% in Dec quarter with unit revenue rising, but supply discipline is industry-wide and nonfuel CASM rose 7.3%.

capex.peers_comment: Bastian said some domestic carriers have cut capacity and that more action is expected next year; competitor hub capacity is down at Atlanta and Detroit.

triggers.label: Competitor domestic ROIC 3% vs Delta 11%
triggers.quote: If you look at the rest of the domestic industry ex Delta, that number is 3%.

triggers.label: Dec-qtr revenue growth ~20% on ~3% capacity
triggers.quote: outlook for December quarter revenue growth of approximately 20% year-over-year on roughly 3% capacity growth

triggers.label: Competitive hub capacity down
triggers.quote: in our hubs, competitive capacity is actually positioned down.

triggers.label: FY EPS guide $5.10-5.60 set

triggers.label: Nonfuel CASM-ex up 7.3%
